title: OpenTyrian — Tyrian 2.1 (Eclipse Productions, 1995), OpenTyrian's SDL 2 port for Windows
author: Eclipse Productions / the OpenTyrian project
notes: Tyrian, the vertical shooter Eclipse Productions made in 1995 and released as freeware in 2004 (its 2.1 data, from camanis.net, where OpenTyrian's README sends for it), on OpenTyrian, its open-source port (GPL; the Windows build of release v2.1.20221123, from the project's GitHub). A Windows program on MIRAGE-WIN32's Universal C Runtime, its SDL2.dll made in JavaScript (machine.hle: PRISM's SDL 2, src/win32/sdl2.js): its frames those of the SDL2.dll beside it, run in x86 without machine.hle, and its music and sound through SDL's audio callback on a thread of the program's; SDL2_net.dll, beside it, runs in x86 on a machine with no network. Arrow keys to move, Space to fire, Enter for the menus.
